name: Robotic microcatheter
full_name: Self-steering robotic microcatheter (series-elastic, two bending segments)
group: Simaan, Vanderbilt (ARMA lab) with Chitale, VUMC
versions: single (2024 T-MRB); path planner in companion paper (ref [45] in abah2024, not read)
devices_driven: own notched-nitinol catheter: outer tube OD 1.2 mm / ID 0.95 mm, intermediate 0.89/0.725, inner 0.66 OD with 0.475 mm bore (S8 check of abah2024 Sec. IV-A); roughly 3.6 Fr at maximum OD (1.2 mm / 0.333, my conversion)
n_dof_detail: 4 (insertion, roll, proximal bend, distal bend; bending in two separate planes)
footprint_mm: N.R. (benchtop actuation unit on aluminium extrusion frame, Fig. 3)
force_sensing: joint-level load sensing via series-elastic actuation; active compliance triggers at 0.01 N tip force (about 1 g)
imaging_compat: bi-plane fluoroscopy for tracking (Fig. 11); catheter tracking and pose filtering algorithms
validation_detail: 2D vasculature model: branch selection left and right, insertion into unknown channel under active compliance, one autonomous deployment along 2D ICA path; no success counts
key_numbers: distal segment OD about 0.88-1.2 mm (text differs, see S8 note); compliance trigger 0.01 N; autonomous insertion errors larger than simulated because passive extension floats between actuation unit and phantom entry
sim_model: kinematic model with calibration and simulated path following along 2D ICA (Fig. 8) (abah2024 Sec. V, full)
sim2real_detail: model-based: planner configurations computed in simulation were run on the hardware; hardware position errors exceeded simulated errors (abah2024 Sec. V-C, full); no learned policy
